study: Determine whether the local SkillOpt/ALFWorld assets support a causal trace-derived skill replay

asset_audit.interpretation: The checkout contains task paths, adapters, prompts, and skills, but not the ALFWorld game payload required to replay an environment deterministically. MATM supplies trajectories and outcomes but not a replayable environment state.

runtime_attempt.failure_summary: MLX server initialization terminated while importing the Metal device backend in the current execution environment; no model response or task episode was emitted.

claim_boundary.reason: The local task payload and executable model runtime are not jointly available, so a causal ALFWorld replay would be an unsupported counterfactual.

next_required: Materialize the exact ALFWorld game payload matching the path manifest and record its revision/hash
Run a supervised local model runtime with an attested listener or use an approved remote model endpoint
Evaluate no-skill, formatting placebo, trace-derived, SkillOpt, SkillGen, and RHO arms on family-disjoint held-out tasks
Keep sealed outcome verification, tool-budget accounting, and release gating independent of the proposer
